entries.subject: NAS1154
entries.note: The .2500-28 dash. TABLE I - DIMENSIONS, row 'NAS1154', all eleven columns read off the render (not the OCR text layer). This is the only NAS1151-1158 dash the endstop worksheet's comments name (rows 33, 35, 49, 53, 55 of WORKSHEET_end_stop_graft.md all read 'NAS1154' verbatim).

gage_diameter.note: Band width .0004 in = 0.0102 mm -- numerically the closest column in this table to the endstop worksheet's 0.01 mm 'fastener size' rows. NOT adopted as the identification: GAGE is a thread pitch-diameter inspection gauge, not a dimension that participates in an assembly clearance. Recorded so the next reader sees why the close number was not simply taken -- see shank_diameter's note and this session's lesson (F6/F7-style value-only-match trap).

shank_diameter.note: The functionally correct reading of 'fastener size' for a clearance-hole stack: the shank diameter, over the thread's unthreaded body, is what actually sits in the mating clearance hole and drives fit/backlash. Band width .0010 in = 0.0254 mm -- disagrees with the endstop worksheet's 0.01 mm (rows 33/35/49/53/55). See gage_diameter's note for the numerically-closer alternative that was considered and rejected on functional grounds.

grip_length_shoulder.note: Column header prints +.010/-.000 -- same 'nominal is the low limit plus the header's printed band' pattern as MS9363/NAS6403's tabulated columns; the .116 cell is the low limit.

overall_length_reference.note: Parenthesized in the table -- a reference dimension, not a toleranced one (the length itself is toleranced separately at ±.015, see the family entry).

notes: This copy's text layer is OCR over a scanned photocopy and is unreliable at the character level (confirmed: 'NAS1154' extracts cleanly but every numeric cell near it does not, e.g. '.4245'/'.4241' extracts as '.0342' -- read the actual pixels, never the text layer, for this document).

Endstop worksheet identification: WORKSHEET_end_stop_graft.md rows 33/35/49/53/55 all carry the comment 'NAS1154' with a 0.01 mm size band. Neither TABLE I column that could plausibly be called a fastener 'size' (shank ØD, 0.0254 mm; gage ØC, 0.0102 mm) matches 0.01 mm exactly. Recorded as a mismatch against shank_diameter (the functionally correct column) in WORKSHEET_endstop_vision_baseline.md's re-trace, 2026-09-04 -- not as a trace, and not as a silent pick of whichever column happened to be closer.
